//: Agent Guard MCP server for Antigravity / Claude Code (any MCP IDE).
//antigravity: Antigravity reads ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json. Some IDEs ignore `cwd`, so PYTHONPATH (below) is REQUIRED — it lets `python -m mcp_server` import from any working directory. Manage/reconnect the server in Antigravity via  Additional Options (…) > MCP Servers.
//setup: 1) start the backend (docker compose up  or  uvicorn). 2) put this in ~/.gemini/config/mcp_config.json (Antigravity) or your project .mcp.json (Claude Code). 3) set the absolute paths, workspace, and (for Docker) the proxy URL + key.

env.//PYTHONPATH: REQUIRED — absolute path to the backend/ dir, so -m mcp_server imports even when the IDE ignores cwd.
env.//AGENTGUARD_URL: Docker: the proxy http://localhost:8080/api (injects the key). Bare uvicorn: http://127.0.0.1:8000
env.//AGENTGUARD_API_KEY: Match the backend key. If omitted, the server reads it from deploy/production.env.
